advisory.finding: The new guard silently skips any alarm_description written as a quoted string rather than a heredoc: `_DESCRIPTION_RE` only matches the `<<-EOT` heredoc form, and non-matching blocks hit `if match is None: continue`. A quoted-string description exceeding 1024 chars (the exact class the guard exists to catch) is therefore invisible to the check.
merged_from: test_alarm_descriptions_fit_the_aws_limit has no anti-vacuity floor: if _DESCRIPTION_RE matches zero descriptions (regex slip, HCL reformat, tag rename), every block continues, `too_long` stays empty, and the test passes vacuously — breaking the explicit anti-vacuity convention the rest of this file enforces via _MIN_EXPECTED_ALARMS / _MIN_EXPECTED_HOST_ALARMS.
scenarios: An operator adds or rewrites an alarm with a quoted-string alarm_description over 1024 chars; the guard passes green and the defect is only caught at `terraform apply`.

merged_from: test_alarm_descriptions_fit_the_aws_limit is fail-open: if _DESCRIPTION_RE matches zero descriptions (heredoc reformat, regex slip), every alarm hits `continue`, too_long stays empty, and the test passes vacuously — it has no anti-vacuity floor even though every other guard in this file has one and the file docstring names vacuity 'the failure mode this guard exists to prevent'.
